title: Hungarian Labour Market Yearbook 2023–2024 (Hermann–Varga eds.)
title_hu: Munkaerőpiaci Tükör 2023–2024 (szerk. Hermann Zoltán, Varga Júlia)
summary_en: The 2023–2024 edition of the Hungarian Labour Market Yearbook (Munkaerőpiaci Tükör), edited by Hermann and Varga, reviews the post-COVID Hungarian labour market with the standard sections (labour-market data, institutional changes, In-Focus thematic chapters). The 2023–2024 volume's thematic focus combines education-system inputs to labour-market outcomes — VET reform impacts, school segregation, six-year-gymnasium selection — alongside the post-pandemic labour-market normalisation analysis.
policy_relevance: Standard reference volume for Hungarian labour-market policy analysts. The 2023–2024 edition is particularly relevant for current Hungarian education-and-labour-market reform agendas (ITM VET system review, BM Köznevelési Stratégia revision) because of its In-Focus emphasis on education-to-labour-market transitions.
